posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a wholesome May photo dump featuring family moments with Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan, along with birthday celebrations and her quest for the perfect hot chocolate.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit announced a historic Wembley Stadium show for Sep 12 — the first South Asian artist to headline the iconic venue — and surprised Toronto fans with the Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's spy thriller Alpha has been preponed to July 3, while Bobby Deol shut down rumors of an on-set clash, praising her professionalism and dedication to the action sequences.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka shared poolside vibes from her Hyderabad base while filming SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu, confirming six months of shoot still pending for the ₹1,300 crore film.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King is confirmed for a Christmas 2026 release — the ₹350 crore action thriller with daughter Suhana Khan marks his return after a three-year gap from the big screen.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film, marking their first collaboration since Bajrangi Bhaijaan over a decade ago.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological epic Mahavatar, while also prepping a period musical drama with director Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika made waves at a Cartier event in Stockholm, hinting at her exit from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit, while juggling King with SRK and Raaka with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 hits JioHotstar on June 4 after an ₹1,800 crore worldwide theatrical run — the second-highest-grossing Indian film ever. His next film Pralay begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya made her 24th Cannes appearance with stunning looks — from ethereal feather glam to a dramatic swan-inspired couture finale that had the fashion world buzzing.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is playing the main villain in Atlee's Raaka opposite Allu Arjun — a bold departure from her Pushpa image — and is also starring in Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is headlining the female-centric action thriller Maa Inti Bangaram while also stepping into producing — 2026 is all about purpose-driven choices for the newly married star.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is deep into filming Raaka with Atlee — a massive VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle where he plays multiple roles, featuring an ensemble cast including Deepika, Rashmika, and Janhvi.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi releases June 4 with AR Rahman's music — the film follows a village athlete's inspiring journey and features a rugged physical transformation.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with KGF director Prashanth Neel is locked for a June 2027 release — the first-time collaboration promises high-octane mass entertainment on an epic scale.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars alongside Ram Charan in Peddi, the highly anticipated sports drama releasing June 4 — she's also part of Allu Arjun's massive Raaka ensemble.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's Chand Mera Dil crossed ₹26 crore in 10 days at the box office — the Dharma romantic drama with Lakshya continues its steady theatrical run in its second week.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara stepped into 2026 with baby Saraayah and is gearing up for her next big screen outing after her fierce turn as Nadia in Yash's Toxic.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is making his directorial debut with Krrish 4, the ambitious superhero saga produced by YRF — pre-production is in full swing with filming set to begin this summer.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai releases June 5 — a special farewell as it marks father David Dhawan's final directorial venture, co-starring Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released her devotional track 'Siddha Bhajo' as a tribute to her father, and announced The Unstoppable Tour hitting major US and UK arenas this September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's music for Ram Charan's Peddi is generating major buzz ahead of its June 4 release — the legendary composer's score elevates the sports drama's emotional core.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's farewell film Jananayagan is eyeing a July release window after his political party's strong showing in Tamil Nadu elections — a new chapter beyond cinema.
